testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.billing.SubscriptionServiceTest

testcase.name: an incomplete Stripe subscription does not grant the tier()
getSubscriptionByOrganizationId should return subscription when found()
webhook cancellation revokes the tier — dashboard cancellations must not leave paid quotas()
createSubscription should throw exception when organization not found()
createSubscription should create subscription when organization exists()
a newer webhook event applies and records when it was synced()
an older webhook event does not overwrite a newer status()
cancelSubscription should cancel subscription and update organization tier()
creating a subscription must not clobber the just-saved stripeCustomerId()
webhook transition to ACTIVE grants the organization the tier it paid for()
a trialing subscription grants the tier — Stripe treats trials as entitled()
